course_name_original: Métodos Basados en el Conocimiento Aplicados a la Empresa
prerequisites: Students must have assimilated knowledge about Intelligent Systems from Artificial Intelligence courses in their previous degrees.
Ability to read and comprehend texts written in English, as much of the bibliography and documentation is in English.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand Knowledge Engineering methods for modeling complex problems in the business domain.
Understand intelligent data analysis methods and know how to apply them in the design of systems oriented towards business decision-making.
Understand metaheuristic techniques and know how to apply them to solve problems in the business domain.
Know how to integrate knowledge-based systems with information management systems already present in the company.

syllabus_topics: Solving complex problems using advanced machine learning techniques.
Practical modeling and resolution of business problems using advanced Machine Learning techniques and Metaheuristics.
teaching_methods: Individual activities on the Virtual Campus

assessment_methods.method: Individual assignments on the Virtual Campus

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, both parts (group work and individual assignments) must be approved with at least 5 out of 10 points. The final grade is calculated as: 0.5 * Group Work + 0.5 * Individual Work. Group work can only be submitted in the ordinary call, and attendance at oral defense sessions is mandatory. For the extraordinary call, previously approved group and individual work will be considered (otherwise graded as 0), forming a 'Trabajos' grade. A mandatory in-person knowledge test must be passed with at least 5 out of 10 points. The final grade is 0.6 * In-person test + 0.4 * 'Trabajos' grade. If no work was presented and approved in the ordinary call, the maximum grade in the extraordinary call is 6 points. Professors may require an in-person defense of submitted assignments for all calls.
